'''Stunning''' is a weave formed with the [[One Power]], it is very painful and it is used to stun and to paralyze an adversary. The male version of this weave is formed by [[Spirit]] and [[Fire]], as was demonstrated by [[Osan'gar]].{{ref/book|7|41}} Another version is formed by Spirit, Air, Water and a touch of Fire used by the [[Red Ajah]], to stun and capture male channelers. Because male channelers are usually stronger than female channelers, an [[Aes Sedai]] alone would normally not be capable of maintaining a [[shield]] over a male channeler, posing a possible danger when hunting for [[False Dragon]]s or maddened male channelers. This is overcome by stunning them to be shielded later by a circle of six for transport to the [[White Tower]] and gentling.
